VALKYRIE_METRICS_FTUE_POPUP.body:
Hi there, and thank you for downloading the Valkyrie!

Before we start, do you consent to your run data being sent to the mod creator?
VALKYRIE_METRICS_FTUE_THANK_YOU.body:
If you change your mind, you can always toggle it off in the mods configuration menu.

Have fun! ~ Félicie
VALKYRIE_METRICS_FTUE_NO_WORRIES.body:
If you change your mind, you can always toggle it on in the mods configuration menu.

Have fun! ~ Félicie
